_readme: Pages the sitemap, the /service-areas/ hub, and the state links read. url is relative to the site root.
State pages live at container-homes/{state}/ only (decided Oct 29). /service-areas/ is the hub that links to them.
gate: the four things a state page needs before it goes live. Set live: true only when all four are true and the page exists, so a held page never shows up as a link.
homesDelivered and transitDays fill the hub card. Leave them as [X] until they're real; never round up.
Square-bracket text is a placeholder for the owner to fill in.

states.name: California
states.holdReason: Approval route (state factory-built certification or local plan check), delivery pricing, climate specs, and a delivered home or named review.

states.name: Colorado
states.holdReason: Cold-climate package: insulation, heat source, snow load rating.

states.name: Utah
states.holdReason: Cold-climate package, plus local zoning for rural land.

states.name: Wyoming
states.holdReason: Cold-climate package and snow load, plus delivery to remote sites.

states.name: New York
states.holdReason: Local zoning (varies a lot by town), cold-climate package, delivery cost from Texas.
